children: Denmark beverage producer's Q3 revenue and EBIT slightly beat analyst expectations
Company delivered 4% underlying net revenue growth and 5.5% EBIT growth in Q3
Full-year organic EBIT growth guidance narrowed to 6–8% amid challenging conditions
Royal Unibrew narrows 2026 organic EBIT growth guidance to 6–8% from 6–10%
Company expects 2026 EBIT of DKK 2,325–2,380 mln versus DKK 2,202 mln in 2025
Net revenue for 2026 expected to be slightly above 2025, reflecting beverage growth and exit from snacks
OWN-BRAND GROWTH - Co said own brands remained the main growth driver in Q3
COMMERCIAL EXECUTION - Market share gains and improved profitability attributed to solid commercial execution, per CEO Lars Jensen
COST AND EFFICIENCY MEASURES - Co said it addressed higher input costs through pricing, cost, and efficiency measures
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 4 "strong buy" or "buy", 10 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the brewers peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Royal Unibrew AS is DKK495.00, about 8.8% above its November 10 closing price of DKK455.00
The stock recently traded at 12 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 13 three months ago
